teacher.resource_rule: Maximum6 workers; choose6 only if physical available and commit headroom both at least10GiB, else3 if both at least6GiB, otherwise stop before any teacher call. Read-only sample retained.

training.objective: CE over all1968 logits plus1.0*(logsumexp(all logits)-logsumexp(deterministically legal logits)); mean per batch. No legal mask at inference.

selection: First prefer checkpoints with raw development legality at least995/1000. Among eligible: highest raw teacher agreement, then raw legality, then earliest step including0. If none eligible, fallback to highest raw teacher agreement, then raw legality, then earliest. Freeze selection before heldout/rollout learned calls.
intake: Reuse exactly32768 v5 TRAIN metadata/labels. All33920 v5 originalgames and before/current boards excluded from fresh selection, together with full known-history registry/latest matched/balanced-v2 before/current/both selected successors. Fresh one root per sourcegame; frozen source-order SHA buckets with seed4082052; only first source setup token consumed, never source answers/themes. No source evaluation cohort reused as training.
forecast: From exactly512 fresh game-disjoint rollout-candidate roots, run each 50k-node teacher once; preserve all512 outcomes including failures and shortPVs. Before any learned call choose earliest128source ordinals with completed legal PV of at least3plies. Stop if insufficient; no adaptive reservoir expansion. All128forecast roots have teacher support for1/2/3prefixes. This intentionally excludes short-PV/mate-in1 cases and is not general-play sampling. Predict3plies autoregressively by unrestricted1968-wayargmax, save all raw choices before scoring; preserve illegal/terminal/failed/notrun denominators and backendfailure latch.
limitations: Raw Stockfish agreement is one bounded teacher measurement, not mathematical correctness, Elo or teaching quality.
The source is a tactical puzzle convenience shard; original-pretraining overlap unknown.
The forecast panel is conditional on a legal50k-node teacherPV of at least3plies; shortPV/mate-in1 candidates excluded with all outcomes retained.
Legality masks appear only in the training objective; raw inference remains unrestricted.
Compare startingv5selected2048 and newlyselectedv6 on identical fresh panels; earlier v5 metrics are historical different-panel observations.
This move-only experiment does not train commentary or prove broad chess or sports understanding.
